what: Observation: five jobs on 7-8 Nov finished their work and then went stale, because another job running at the same time landed a change to governed files first (latest: the retry of the two new defaults.toml entries, after the verifier-rule landing). Each stale job's spend is lost unless retried, and two jobs that both edit governed files keep being run side by side.
why: Repeated pattern in the drain log; reporting it so Athena's own loop can decide whether to serialize jobs that touch governed files, or re-check and land a stale change on top of the new base. Not fixing it by hand.
